chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
The believers are equals to one another.

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: al-Sadiq; Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad عليه السلام
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنُونَ: the believers; those characterized by iman (faith)
key_terms.بَعْضُهُمْ: some of them; one group in relation to another

ai.seo_question: Are believers considered compatible and equal to one another in marriage?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that believers are socially comparable to one another. In the chapter context, this serves as a concise principle relevant to compatibility in marriage among the believers.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4385 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said: "
Believers are equals to one another."
